functions.name: dependabot_alerts
functions.description: Dependabot vulnerability alerts at repository ID plus alert number, unified across repository, organization and direct lookup. Dismisser and assignees retain distinct roles. Package ecosystem/name describe a dependency, not a GitHub Packages registry entity. All visible states are retained when filters are omitted; fixed and dismissed are distinct outcomes. Direct repository context is analytical; advisory and dismisser navigation do not create additional actor/repository analytical paths.

metrics.comment: Selected alerts, not advisory or dependency occurrences.

metrics.name: dismissed_dependabot_alert_count
metrics.comment: Manual and automatic dismissals, distinct from fixed alerts.

derived_fields.comment: UTC date from the returned created_at instant.

functions.name: security_advisories
functions.description: One canonical GHSA identity across global database and repository advisory populations. Global type and repository workflow state remain separate nullable concepts. Repository and global patch metadata retain their distinct first-patched-version and patched-ranges fields. Organization responses contain no owning repository identity, so repository context is honestly NULL there; global source-code URLs are not invented repository keys. Author, publisher and credited accounts remain distinct. Global, organization and repository visibility differs; inaccessible private records fail rather than disappearing.

metrics.name: draft_security_advisory_count
metrics.comment: Repository advisories explicitly in draft workflow state; no draft state is inferred for global records.

derived_fields.name: security_advisory_published_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC date from the returned published_at instant.

functions.name: dependency_changes
functions.description: Dependency additions/removals observed for a requested base...head comparison, qualified by repository, comparison token, manifest, ecosystem, name, version, scope and change direction. Moving ref tokens are observation context rather than stable commit IDs. Repeated exact identities fail instead of inflating counts. Vulnerability associations remain typed nested evidence, not extra changed dependency rows.

metrics.name: dependency_change_count
metrics.comment: Selected changed dependency coordinates within one comparison observation.

dependency_change_vulnerability_count.comment: Advisory associations on changed dependency records; one advisory affecting several coordinates counts several associations.

functions.name: dependency_sboms
functions.description: Typed SPDX document snapshots at repository ID and document namespace. Packages and SPDX relationships retain typed nested fields; entries are not equated with GitHub Packages registry records. creationInfo.created is a string in the pinned API, so it remains unparsed text. Optional SPDX fields and missing relationships remain unknown. This synchronous export is deprecated in the pinned contract; asynchronous report downloads have a separate content/status contract and are not silently counted as typed SBOM snapshots.

metrics.name: dependency_sbom_count
metrics.comment: Selected SPDX document snapshots, not historical SBOM inventory.

sbom_package_entry_count.comment: Declared package entries in selected documents, including the root repository package; not distinct registry packages.

sbom_relationship_entry_count.comment: SPDX relationship entries where reported; absent relationship data remains NULL.
